orders.not-found: The requested order was not found
orders.soft-deleted: Order was soft deleted (hidden from the customer).

cancel.not-cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.

transition.not-allowed: This order cannot move to that status from where it is now.
transition.cancel-elsewhere: Cancelling an order runs the cancellation sequence — cancel it through the order's cancel endpoint instead.

orders.items-held: This order's items cannot be changed while its stock is held or already sold.
orders.insufficient-stock: Some items on this order are no longer available in the quantity requested — see `details.lines`.
